options.name: address
options.description: The reserved address.

options.name: comment
options.description: The description for the fixed address. May contain 0 to 1024 characters. Can include UTF-8.

options.name: dhcp_options
options.description: The list of DHCP options. May be either a specific option or a group of options.

options.name: disable_dhcp
options.description: Optional. I(true) to disable object. The fixed address is converted to an exclusion when generating configuration. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: header_option_filename
options.description: The configuration for header option filename field.

options.name: header_option_server_address
options.description: The configuration for header option server address field.

options.name: header_option_server_name
options.description: The configuration for header option server name field.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The DHCP host name associated with this fixed address. It is of FQDN type and it defaults to empty.

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the object

options.name: inheritance_parent
options.description: The resource identifier.

options.name: inheritance_sources
options.description: The inheritance configuration.

options.name: ip_space
options.description: The resource identifier.

options.name: match_type
options.description: Indicates how to match the client: * I(mac): match the client MAC address for both IPv4 and IPv6, * I(client_text) or I(client_hex): match the client identifier for IPv4 only, * I(relay_text) or I(relay_hex): match the circuit ID or remote ID in the DHCP relay agent option (82) for IPv4 only, * I(duid): match the DHCP unique identifier, currently match only for IPv6 protocol.

options.name: match_value
options.description: The value to match.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the fixed address. May contain 1 to 256 characters. Can include UTF-8.

options.name: next_available_id
options.description: The resource identifier for the fixed address where the next available fixed address should be generated.

options.name: parent
options.description: The resource identifier.

options.name: portal_key
options.description: The API token for authentication against Infoblox BloxOne API. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_KEY) will be used.

options.name: portal_url
options.description: The Infoblox Cloud Services Portal (CSP) URL. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_URL) will be used.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the object

options.name: tags
options.description: The tags for the fixed address in JSON format.
